subject: Retention flooring & seatless transition proposal for observability addons
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention flooring & seatless transition proposal for observability addons

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Based on our conversation I put together a short note on options for Orion's move from a seat-based dashboard model to a seatless observability plan (tracing + retention + advanced dashboards). High level:

- Problem: current spend spikes when long retention is enabled (30–90d) and dashboards are seat-tied; you need predictable unit economics for a multi‑tenant ingest profile.
- Goal: give Orion a path to seatless dashboards while protecting revenue with a modest retention "floor" (minimum TB‑month commit) and an adjustable step-down for longtail storage.

Attached: pricing_model_v1.xlsx (simple scenarios).

Ask from our side: can you confirm monthly trace ingest (avg GB/day) and the % of traces you expect to keep at 30d vs 90d? Also: procurement timeline and whether a short POC SOW would accelerate sign-off.

Proposed immediate next step: 30‑minute slot this week for Marcus/Kimberly to walk through two commercial options and SOW outline. Marcus — can you take lead on optioning?

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_model_v1.xlsx (Excel, 87KB)

From: Emma Park <emma@orionhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention flooring & seatless transition proposal for observability addons

Hi David + team —

Thanks — we are interested. Quick answers:
- Average trace ingest: ~2.2 GB/day currently, expected to grow to ~4–5 GB/day in Q1 next year.
- Retention split: ~70% of traces we keep 30d, ~30% we want archived to 90d for compliance.
- Procurement timeline: team expects to have commercial approval window 6–8 weeks; legal may need a SOC 2 addendum.

Couple of asks before the call:
1) Clarify what you mean by "flooring" — minimum TB-month commit and how it affects per-GB pricing?
2) How do trace ingestion and dashboard seatless access interplay — is dashboard access billed separately?

I've attached a marked-up SOW template from our side previously used with other vendors (will send redlines after internal review).

Thanks,
Emma Park
Director, Observability Platform
Orion Health Systems

Attachment: Orion_SOW_template_for_vendors.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@orionhealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention flooring & seatless transition proposal for observability addons

Emma — quick commercial sketch ahead of the call. I pulled the scenarios into the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-orion-retention-proposal

Option A — Floor + step-down (recommended for predictable economics):
- 1 TB/month floor (committed) priced at $1,200/TB-month.
- Above-floor usage metered at $180/TB for 30d retention, $95/TB additional for 90d archival (charged as incremental TB-months).
- Floor amortized across months with a quarterly true-up.

Option B — Seatless slab (better for rapid scale, higher short‑term cost predictability):
- Flat slab price covering dashboards (seatless) + 30d retention for up to 3 TB/month at $3,900/month.
- Overage metered at $220/TB for ingestion, $110/TB for 90d archival.

Concessions available for pilot / accelerated close:
- 30% demo credit applied to first 2 months of metered fees, or
- Waive the floor for the first 60 days of the pilot with a limited Egress cap.

I attached a draft SOW (SOW_draft.docx) with milestones: pilot, performance gate (latency & query SLA), and roll-to-prod acceptance.

Happy to walk through the math — David, can we propose Wed 09/22 10:00 PT for the walkthrough?

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_draft.docx (DOCX, 24KB)

From: Emma Park <emma@orionhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention flooring & seatless transition proposal for observability addons

Marcus / David —

Appreciate the clarity. A few counterpoints from Orion:
- Floor: 1 TB/month is higher than we anticipated given current ingest. Can we set a 0.5 TB/month floor for the first 6 months with a staged step to 1 TB if we hit growth triggers?
- Demo credit: would you consider 45% applied to the first 3 months instead of 30% for us to commit internal resources to the pilot?
- Metering: confirm that dashboard seatless access is included in the slab but that heavy query egress (replay / export) is metered separately — we need a clear egress cap to avoid surprises.

Procurement: we will return redlines to the SOW by EOD Thursday; legal will require SOC 2 evidence and a short data processing addendum.

If you can agree to the 0.5 TB initial floor + 45% pilot credit we can commit to a pilot kickoff by 10/01 and are willing to sign a 9‑month conversion SOW on successful gates.

Thanks,
Emma

Attachment: Orion_SOW_redlines.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Retention flooring & seatless transition proposal for observability addons — internal summary and ask

Team — forwarding the thread and redlines from Orion. Summary / ask:
- Orion asks for an initial 0.5 TB floor for 6 months (staged bump to 1 TB on growth trigger).
- They request 45% pilot/demo credit applied to first 3 months.
- SOC2 + DPA + SOW redlines incoming; procurement timeline ~6–8 weeks; target pilot kickoff by 2026-10-01.

Recommended concession (aim to close pilot):
1) Approve temporary floor reduction to 0.5 TB for first 6 months, with auto-step to 1 TB if monthly ingest >0.9 TB for two consecutive months.
2) Offer a 35% pilot credit (compromise) instead of 45% — preserves revenue while giving them headroom to justify resources.
3) Legal to fast-track SOC2 evidence and addendum; Marcus / Kimberly to own SOW redline response.

Please reply with approvals or escalation points. If Ben agrees, I will send a formal counter with updated SOW and timeline.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
